items.title: 极致动态设计序列 — 15秒品牌识别
items.prompt:
Ultra-sleek motion design sequence. Pure black background throughout. White-on-black minimal aesthetic. No cuts — one single continuous unbroken visual evolution. Locked-off static center frame, no camera movement. All motion occurs within the subject. Self-luminous white forms on absolute black, no grain, no shadows.

0–1s [ORIGIN]: A single white point materializes at center frame. It pulses once — three concentric rings ripple outward like a heartbeat and dissolve into black.

1–2s [LINE]: The point stretches into a razor-thin white horizontal line extending edge to edge with elastic ease-out motion.

2–4s [GRID → CIRCLE]: The line multiplies into a precise grid of nine parallel horizontal and vertical lines appearing in staggered succession. The grid warps — outer lines curve inward, the structure rotates, straight lines bend into arcs, converging into a perfect geometric circle outline.

4–6s [WIREFRAME → SOLID SPHERE]: The circle extrudes into a 3D wireframe sphere, every latitude and longitude line crisp, slowly rotating on its vertical axis. The wireframe fills in smoothly — dissolving into a solid white surface with a soft specular highlight in the upper-left quadrant.

6–8s [INTERFACE]: The sphere flattens and unfolds into a clean rectangular plane — a minimal phone interface with rounded corners. Abstract UI elements appear inside: status bar, a grid of rounded app icons, home indicator bar. White line art on black.

8–10s [CUBE → BLOOM]: The interface folds inward, collapsing into an isometric wireframe cube that tumbles once. The cube's six faces peel outward simultaneously, each becoming a smooth white elliptical petal — blooming open like a flower in zero gravity.

10–12s [VORTEX]: The flower dissolves into hundreds of tiny white particles orbiting the center in a controlled elliptical vortex, some clockwise, some counterclockwise, each following a precise mathematical path, flickering softly.

12–13s [WATCH]: The particles decelerate and self-organize — converging and snapping into position to assemble the silhouette of a wristwatch: a clean rectangular case outline with lugs, built entirely from particles.

13–14s [COLLAPSE]: The watch dissolves into fluid white ribbons that compress into a single dense white sphere. It pulses once — brighter than before — then collapses rapidly inward to a single brilliant point.

14–15s [LOGO]: The point holds for one silent beat. Then it expands into a clean minimal brand logo — white sans-serif letterforms on black. A single pulse of warm amber light blooms from center behind the logo, fades to black. White text remains.

Style: luxury tech brand motion identity, Bauhaus-minimalist, mathematical precision. Mood: calm, inevitable, intelligent, premium.

items.title: 吸血姬变身 — 全能参考提示词
items.prompt:
Shot One: Everyday Home Scene Time Segment: 0:00 to 0:02 Shot Distance and Type: Medium shot, handheld follow-cam Camera Movement Path and Speed: The camera subtly sways with the character's movements, with a light, upbeat, and lively rhythm. The camera follows the trajectory of the girl's arm waving, finally facing the prop she raises. Main Subject Actions and Expression: The girl is wearing white loungewear pajamas patterned with Crayon Shin-chan designs and a bear hairband. She holds a sheet of white paper rolled into the shape of a telescope. She first playfully waves this "paper telescope" with a smile on her face, then directly aims one end of the "paper telescope" at and fully presses it against the lens, using the physical darkness inside the paper tube to block the frame, creating a perfect transition medium. Visual Effects: No obvious effects, belonging to everyday real-light-and-shadow recording. Cleverly utilizes the dark circular hole inside the paper tube rolled into a telescope shape as a physical transition entry medium. Overall Color Tone and Mood: Warm white tones, bright. Mood is relaxed, everyday, and lively, laying the groundwork for the dramatic contrast to follow.

Shot Two: Spacetime Tunnel Transition Time Segment: 0:02 to 0:04 Shot Distance and Type: Close-up transitioning to full wide shot, first-person perspective push-in Camera Movement Path and Speed: The camera rapidly pushes forward at high speed, visually as if directly penetrating the inner hole of the "paper telescope" the girl pressed against the lens in the previous second, delivering an extremely strong visual impact and a sense of extreme speed. Main Subject Actions and Expression: No character subject, primarily showcasing the process of traversing space. Visual Effects: Intense CG visual effects, deep red vortex and wormhole effects with a strong sense of suction and spatial distortion, followed by bats flying out from the depths of the frame as visual guides. Overall Color Tone and Mood: Interwoven dark red and black. Mood shifts instantly from relaxed to mysterious, dangerous, and filled with a sense of the unknown.

Shot Three: Vampire Princess Descends Time Segment: 0:04 to 0:06 Shot Distance and Type: Overhead full wide shot transitioning to medium shot, panning camera (downward pan) Camera Movement Path and Speed: The camera pans from top to bottom, aligning with the character's upward gaze, with speed transitioning from fast to slow motion, creating tremendous visual tension. Main Subject Actions and Expression: The transformed vampire princess (white hair, elven ears, white ornate gown, red nails) gazes up at the lens from below, extending one hand toward the lens as if inviting or casting a spell, her expression alluring yet brimming with dangerous allure. Visual Effects: Strong slow-motion (high-frame-rate) treatment, with a large amount of red petals or light-spot particles drifting in the foreground, a red magical halo floating above the character's head, and a background of intersecting black Gothic tree branches and net-like structures. Overall Color Tone and Mood: Intense dark red blended with high-contrast cool white tones. Mood is mysterious, seductive, and infused with Gothic opulence.

Shot Four: Alluring Freeze-Frame Time Segment: 0:06 to 0:09 Shot Distance and Type: Medium close-up, with a slight handheld push-pull feel Camera Movement Path and Speed: The camera remains relatively fixed but with a breathing and subtle tremor sensation, syncing with the music's beat for a strong rhythmic pulse. Main Subject Actions and Expression: The character holds the extended-hand pose, lightly touching her lips with the other hand, her gaze locked directly on the lens, her expression radiating immense allure and oppressive intensity. Visual Effects: Incorporates frame-skipping, rapid flickers, subtle screen distortion (glitch-fault style), and radial blur effects, paired with high-frequency red light flashes to amplify visual impact and cyberpunk vibes. Overall Color Tone and Mood: Large areas of high-saturation red background, with the character at the absolute visual center. Mood is high-energy, intensely visually aggressive.

Shot Five: Blood Moon Flight Time Segment: 0:09 to 0:12 Shot Distance and Type: Long shot, fixed camera Camera Movement Path and Speed: The camera remains steady, with elements in the frame exhibiting a slow floating sensation. Main Subject Actions and Expression: The character unfurls massive demonic wings, hovering in the night sky in an expansive pose. Visual Effects: Grand scene compositing, with a massive blood moon in the background, rendered with dark red cloud layers; slow-motion flocks of bats accompany in flight, evoking a powerful epic atmosphere. Overall Color Tone and Mood: Dark fantasy tones dominated by black and red. Mood is grand, awe-inspiring, and brimming with dominance, perfectly echoing the video's theme.

items.title: 赌场扑克牌飞行 — 15秒电影级第一视角
items.prompt:
## Project Overview

Generate a 15-second casino poker card flight video, where the King of Spades flies out from the hand of a sexy female dealer, traversing the entire luxurious casino from a tight-following card's perspective, and finally being stealthily passed into the player's hand from behind and below. Focus on optimizing the smooth rotation of the card during flight and the covert nature of the card-receiving action.

## Video Specifications
- Total Duration: 15 seconds
- Aspect Ratio: 16:9 (Landscape)
- Visual Style: Realistic style, cinematic texture, high-speed photography, motion blur, dramatic lighting

## Core Optimization Requirements

### Perspective Strategy
- Tight-Follow Card Perspective: Camera always closely follows the poker card, like the card's "first-person view"
- Card Face Orientation Logic:
  - Opening (Shot 1): Card front (King of Spades) facing camera
  - Flight Process (Shots 2-6): Card back facing camera
  - Landing in Hand (Shot 7): Card flips at the moment it lands in the player's palm

### Optimized Shot-by-Shot Script (5 Units)

Unit 1 (Shots 1-2, 4s): Close-up of sexy female dealer, Asian woman ~25yo, phoenix eyes, high ponytail, deep V-neck white shirt, holding King of Spades front facing camera. Card flicked out, camera switches to tight-follow card back perspective, smooth rotation past gaming tables.

Unit 2 (Shots 3-4, 4s): Card ascends along spiral staircase's curved trajectory, golden railings and crystal chandeliers rotating past. Then high-speed straight-line corridor traverse with motion blur.

Unit 3 (Shots 5-6, 4s): Card dives from second floor into lobby, wide-angle grand space, marble floor and chandelier enlarging. Card slows, approaching target player from behind and below (low angle).

Unit 4 (Shot 7, 2s): Card stealthily passed from behind and below into player's hand, flips at landing — King of Spades front clearly facing camera. Close-up male hand with slender fingers.

Unit 5 (Shot 8, 1s): Quick cut back to dealer's confident smile or wink, warm lighting.

### Design Focus (Priority Order)
1. Card Flight Posture: smooth fluid rotation, no shaking
2. Card-Receiving Covertness: stealthy, natural
3. Final Card Face: King of Spades front facing camera
4. Tight-Follow Perspective
5. Card Face Orientation Changes: front → back → flip to front
6. Spiral Staircase Realism
7. Motion Continuity
8. Luxurious Atmosphere: golden, deep red, dramatic lighting

items.title: 2D 雕刻变形为真人女性
items.prompt: The 2D carved woman gradually becomes human. Natural skin colour starts to appear in her finger tips and the natural skin colour quickly spreads across her skin. Her face turns towards the camera as it morphs into a beautiful woman's face that has the same features as the stone carving. Her bracelet, necklace and headdress become real gold and are embedded with stunning gems. Her carved dress becomes satin red fabric. She steps out of the wall carving and holds her hand out towards the camera.
items.author: PZF

items.title: 雅加达 KRL 通勤线车站的电影级恐怖场景
items.prompt: cinematic horror. Jakarta KRL Commuter Line station at night, Sudirman station platform, harsh yellow-white fluorescent overhead lighting, worn dirty tiled floor, blue KRL train car parked at platform, Indonesian signage on walls. A young woman in [reference outfit] poses next to the train car taking a selfie, smiling. On the train wall behind her, a large advertisement poster shows a beautiful woman's face. The poster surface begins to ripple and crack. Long black wet hair pushes through the glossy paper. A pale hand with black fingernails tears through. A kuntilanak in torn white kebaya crawls out of the poster completely, feet never touching the ground, long hair covering her face, head tilted at an unnatural angle. Bystanders on the platform scream and scatter. The woman drops her phone and runs. POV handheld tracking shot, she sprints through the platform, quick glance back, the kuntilanak glides at impossible speed closing the distance, hair flowing, white kebaya tattered. Emergency lights flicker red. Train doors slam shut. Dead end. Wide shot the woman presses her back against the closed train doors, nowhere to go. The kuntilanak stops. Slowly raises her head. Two hollow black eyes beneath the hair. Shaky handheld cam, motion blur, high contrast shadows, horror aesthetic, cinematic.
items.author: 🌸 Bubskyy 🌸

items.title: 2D Animated Fight Scene
items.prompt: A 2D animated fight scene between two characters, Anya and Kannakamui. Anya moves quickly, circling around and delivering many punches and flying kicks. The ground cracks and dust rises into the air. Kannakamui twists and turns her body rapidly, using quick movements, dodges, and blocks to avoid the attacks. Each strike creates gusts of wind and loud impact sounds. The motion and shifts in body control are clearly shown. The animation is smooth and synchronized, making the fight feel powerful and full of weight.

items.title: Man vs. Sea Monster in a Violent Storm
items.prompt: A lone man struggles to steady himself on a small boat in the middle of a violent ocean storm. Thunder cracks and heavy rain lashes down as towering waves crash around him. Suddenly, a sea monster bursts from the dark water, its massive jaws opening wide. It clamps its teeth onto the boat, splintering the wood, and violently drags it beneath the churning ocean as the man fights for his life. Dramatic lighting, cinematic camera angles, hyper-realistic, intense atmosphere.
